description: Cross-reference SBOM components against OSV.dev vulnerability database. Returns CVE IDs, CVSS scores, severity, and fix recommendations. Accepts directory_path (generates fresh) or sbom_path (loads saved artifact).

directory_path.description: Path to project root (generates fresh SBOM)

severity_threshold.description: Only report vulnerabilities at or above this severity (default: low)

name: sbom_scan_vulnerabilities
